description: A hierarchical data table that displays flat data with parent/child relationships as an expandable tree. Supports columns, row selection, inline editing, pagination, and drag-to-select multi-selection.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: Flat list of items. Each item must expose an id and a parent id.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Column definitions (TmTreeListColumn children).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the wrapper element.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Alternative column definitions provided as a list (useful when CascadingValue does not propagate).

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: Current page when pagination is enabled.

parameters.name: Editable
parameters.description: Enables inline row editing via double-click.

parameters.name: ExpandedIds
parameters.description: Initial set of expanded item ids. Mutated by user interaction.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Optional filter predicate. When set, only matching rows and their ancestors are visible.

parameters.name: IdSelector
parameters.description: Function that returns the unique id of an item.

parameters.name: IndentSize
parameters.description: Indent size per level in rem units. Default: 1.5.

parameters.name: MultiSelect
parameters.description: Enables multi-selection via Ctrl/Shift click and drag-to-select.

parameters.name: OnRowSelect
parameters.description: Fires when a row is clicked (only when Selectable is true).

parameters.name: OnCollapse
parameters.description: Fires when an item is collapsed.

parameters.name: OnExpand
parameters.description: Fires when an item is expanded.

parameters.name: OnRowEdit
parameters.description: Fires when an inline edit is committed.

parameters.name: OnSelectionChange
parameters.description: Fires when a row is clicked (only when is true).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Page size for pagination. 0 disables pagination.

parameters.name: PageSizeOptions
parameters.description: Optional page-size dropdown values. When null the dropdown is hidden.

parameters.name: ParentIdSelector
parameters.description: Function that returns the parent id, or null for root items.

parameters.name: Selectable
parameters.description: Enables row click selection.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: Optional sort key selector. When set, siblings are sorted by this value.

parameters.name: SortDescending
parameters.description: When true, sorts in descending order. Default is ascending.
